package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for http_writeheader_after_write: Handlers that write the response body before calling WriteHeader(...).
// fixture polarity: positive; family: idioms; severity: info.
func partialHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Write([]byte(`{"partial":true`))
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	w.Write([]byte(`,"done":true}`))
}

func streamHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	type Item struct {
		Name string `json:"name"`
		ID   int    `json:"id"`
	}
	data, _ := json.Marshal(Item{Name: "test", ID: 1})
	w.Write(data)
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
}
